rateCopy.title: Generate a rate copy
rateCopy.description: wofella adds a new difficulty at this rate, with its own time-stretched audio, next to the original chart.
rateCopy.writes_one: wofella writes {{count}} new file into this set folder; it never overwrites or deletes anything.
rateCopy.writes_other: wofella writes {{count}} new files into this set folder; it never overwrites or deletes anything.
rateCopy.writesNothing: Both files already exist; wofella writes nothing and never overwrites or deletes anything.
rateCopy.refused: This rate copy can't be made

refusal.unsupported_mode: Only osu!mania charts can get a rate copy.
refusal.keysounded: This chart uses keysounds or storyboard samples, which a rate copy cannot keep in time.
refusal.no_audio: This chart has no audio file.
refusal.audio_missing: The chart's audio file is missing from its set folder.
refusal.malformed: The chart's .osu file could not be read.
refusal.rate_out_of_range: This rate is outside the range wofella can generate.
refusal.identity_rate: 1.00x is the chart itself; pick another rate.
refusal.already_rate_copy: This chart is already a rate copy; make one from the original chart instead.
refusal.ln_heavy: This chart is mostly long notes; rate copies of LN-heavy charts are not supported yet.
refusal.same_column_collision: At this rate, two notes in one column would land too close together; try another rate.
refusal.unsafe_name: The copy's file names would not be valid for osu! stable.
refusal.already_exists: A file with the copy's name already exists and is not this rate copy; wofella never overwrites it.
refusal.unknown: This rate copy can't be made.

rateCopy.done: Done. In osu!, press F5 in song select to see the new difficulty, then sync wofella.
